title: oxalis fragrans
intro: Oxalis fragrans, commonly known as the Fragrant Wood Sorrel, is a flowering plant species within the Oxalis genus, characterized by its pink or purple flowers and fragrant foliage. The health benefits of Oxalis fragrans include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its calming and sedative effects, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. Oxalis fragrans contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may contribute to its medicinal properties and are currently being researched for their potential benefits in treating various health conditions.
